selected_policy: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Symptoms include BOTH of the following: significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.) AND unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity resulting in disability.
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: The patient has severe, unremitting daily pain radiating down the right upper extremity into the shoulder and hand with numbness. Functional impact: Significant disability affecting work and daily activities of daily living.
criterion_evaluations.policy_citation:
[3] Section: CMM-601.4: Initial Primary Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) > Radiculopathy (TOC: S9.1.1) - Radiculopathy
- Symptoms include BOTH of the following:
- significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.)
- unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity resulting in disability

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Physical exam findings include ANY of the following: dermatomal sensory deficit, motor deficit (e.g., biceps, triceps weakness), reflex changes, shoulder abduction relief sign, nerve root tension sign (e.g., Spurling's maneuver), unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity without concordant objective physical exam findings.
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Physical Exam: Motor: Weakness; Sensory: Deficit; Reflexes: Depressed; Provocative Signs: Spurling maneuver is positive.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following (unless contraindicated): prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for six (6) weeks OR provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician) for six (6) weeks OR epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) performed at the same level(s) as the requested surgery.
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: The patient completed 8 weeks (16 visits) of provider-directed physical therapy. Discharge Assessment: Patient achieved less than clinically meaningful functional improvement despite faithful adherence.

notes: The patient meets the criteria for initial primary ACDF based on radiculopathy and myelopathy. The radiculopathy criteria include significant daily pain, functional impairment, and objective physical exam findings (weakness, sensory deficit, positive Spurling's). The myelopathy criteria include symptoms (weakness, numbness) and physical exam findings (weakness, sensory deficit, depressed reflexes). Imaging (MRI) shows neural compression concordant with the clinical picture. The patient has failed conservative management (physical therapy) for 8 weeks. The patient is documented as nicotine-free based on a negative cotinine test. X-rays were performed. All other required criteria are met.
